sources.author: Heval
patch_list: Makes the dark theme pure black on OLED screens.
Adds switches to turn off or speed up animations.
Removes tracking codes from shared links.
Makes the match rows in lists shorter so more fit on screen.
Disables Facebook ads and tracking. Facebook login keeps working.
Hides the prompt to share a screenshot.
Unlocks premium features. AI insights stay locked.
Makes Google sign-in and Google services work. Requires MicroG RE.
Hides AI insights on match pages.
Hides the competitions you pick in Patch settings from match lists, leagues and search.
Hides the countries you pick in Patch settings from match lists, leagues and search.
Adds switches to hide tabs from the bottom bar.
Hides the Chat button on match and league pages.
Adds switches to hide match page tabs.
Adds switches to hide promotional sections.
Adds switches to hide sports you don't follow.
Keeps the screen on while a match page is open.
Adds a screen to turn supported features on or off.
Refreshes home screen widgets every hour instead of every 30 minutes.
Lets you hide scores for matches and competitions you mark, and goal alerts for matches you mark.
Fixes Google features that check the app's original signature.
Highlight videos wait for a tap instead of playing on their own.
Opens the hidden developer menu without the password.
